contestants.name: James becky
contestants.bio: James Becky stands for unwavering integrity and a bold vision for our future. With a steadfast commitment to excellence and a lifetime of dedicated service, he is ready to lead our community forward. Vote for James Becky to experience transformative leadership built on trust, transparency, and a relentless pursuit of progress for all.

contestants.name: Mailik
contestants.bio: Driven by unwavering integrity and a bold vision, Mailik champions a standard of excellence rooted in dedicated service to our community. With a tireless commitment to turning shared aspirations into tangible progress, Mailik represents leadership you can trust. Cast your vote for principled action and lasting impact; vote for Mailik.
